ceterms:description.en-US: This course builds on the writing and rhetorical skills developed in Composition 1 and 2. Students create five major projects, which ask them to practice technical writing genres as a way to apply important concepts in the field, like document design, usability testing, communication ethics, and collaborative writing. Prerequisite: ENGL 10103 and ENGL 10203 or equivalent. (Typically offered: Fall, Spring and Summer)
